company.shortDescription: Built is the leading AI-native platform for real estate and construction finance.
company.description: Built is the leading AI-native platform for real estate and construction finance. We help lenders, developers, and contractors save time and money by replacing spreadsheets, email, and manual work with a single system for draws, inspections, and payments. With Built, capital moves faster, data stays clean, and risk stays in check. More than 625 banks, private credit lenders, owners, and general contractors rely on Built to manage over $350 billion in real estate and construction activity annually. Learn more at www.getbuilt.com.
